parsed.post: Found a new personal best of 0.907184! Halving the batch size to 262144 while keeping DEPTH=6 and all shards seems to be working well, providing more optimizer steps. Next, I'll try increasing the learning rate slightly to 0.1 to see if we can accelerate convergence with these extra steps.
parsed.description: Halved TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase step count and increased MATRIX_LR to 0.1 to attempt faster convergence.
